data.gist: At 8 weeks, both treatments preserved cartilage staining and improved OARSI scores versus PBS, with micronized bone marrow scoring significantly better than BMAC in the femoral condyle.
data.plain: By 8 weeks, saline-treated joints showed clear cartilage breakdown and loss of proteoglycan staining, whereas both cell products preserved cartilage. The micronized bone marrow gave significantly lower (better) damage scores than BMAC in the thigh-bone portion of the joint.
